results.title: Y2K Baby Tee — Butterfly Print
results.description: Super cute early 2000s baby tee with butterfly graphic. Fitted crop length. Tag says medium but fits like a small.

results.title: Graphic Tee — 2003 Tour Bootleg Style
results.description: Vintage-style bootleg tee with faded graphic. Slightly boxy fit. 100% cotton, soft and worn-in.

results.title: Mesh Long-Sleeve Top — Black
results.description: Sheer black mesh long-sleeve. Great for layering under a graphic tee or over a bralette. Stretchy material, fits true to size.

results.title: Vintage Band Tee — Faded Grey
results.description: Faded grey band-style tee with distressed graphic. Crew neck. Fits boxy. Well-loved but no holes or major damage.

results.title: Low-Rise Cargo Pants — Khaki
results.description: Y2K era low-rise cargo pants. Lots of pockets. Khaki color, slightly distressed at the hems. Great for layering with a long tee.

results.title: Vintage Graphic Hoodie — Faded Black
results.description: Faded black pullover hoodie with barely-visible vintage graphic on the chest. Cozy interior. Some pilling but adds to the worn-in look.
